7.7.3.3 Monitor internal debounce algorithm
Monitor internal debouncing is used, if the event does not need debouncing or requires
a more complex debouncing that is not covered by counter or time based debouncing.
In that case the monitor reports only qualified results to the Dem and DEM_EVENT_
STATUS_PREFAILED and DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED cannot be used (eg.
Dem_SetEventStatusWithMonitorData, Dem_SetEventStatus...) in a call of
Dem_SetEventStatus.
[SWS_Dem_01408] Behavior on invalid use of pre qualified results
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04068
⌈If the configuration container DemDebounceAlgorithmClass is set to DemDe-
bounceMonitorInternal for an event and any API reporting an event status by
Dem_EventStatusType is called with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED or DEM_-
EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED for that event, the Dem shall report the DET error DEM_
E_WRONG_CONFIGURATION.⌋

7.7.3.3 Monitor internal debounce algorithm
[SWS_Dem_00437] ⌈If the configuration container DemDebounceAlgorithmClass
is set to DemDebounceMonitorInternal, the Dem module shall not use a Dem-
internal debounce mechanism for each individual event, to qualify the reported event.⌋
(RS_Diag_04068)
Note: The monitor is not allowed to report the event states DEM_EVENT_STATUS_-
PREFAILED and DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED for monitor internal debouncing.
